+from sympy import SingularityFunction, symbols, latex
+
+x, a, n = symbols('x a n')
+
+# Test basic SingularityFunction
+sf = SingularityFunction(x, 4, 5)
+print("Basic SingularityFunction:")
+print(f"  Expression: {sf}")
+print(f"  LaTeX: {latex(sf)}")
+
+# Test SingularityFunction raised to a power
+sf_pow = SingularityFunction(x, 4, 5)**2
+print("\nSingularityFunction raised to power 2:")
+print(f"  Expression: {sf_pow}")
+print(f"  LaTeX: {latex(sf_pow)}")
+
+# Test SingularityFunction raised to a symbolic power
+sf_pow_sym = SingularityFunction(x, 4, 5)**n
+print("\nSingularityFunction raised to symbolic power n:")
+print(f"  Expression: {sf_pow_sym}")
+print(f"  LaTeX: {latex(sf_pow_sym)}")
+
+# Test the original issue case
+from sympy.physics.continuum_mechanics import Beam
+E = symbols("E")
+L = symbols("L")
+F = symbols("F")
+B, H = symbols("B, H")
+I = B * H**3 / 12
+
+b2 = Beam(L, E, I)
+b2.apply_load(-F, L / 2, -1)
+b2.apply_support(0, "fixed")
+R0, M0 = symbols("R_0, M_0")
+b2.solve_for_reaction_loads(R0, M0)
+
+result = b2.shear_force()
+print("\nBeam shear force (original issue):")
+print(f"  Expression: {result}")
+print(f"  LaTeX: {latex(result)}")
+print("\nSuccess! No error occurred.")
